tasks.description: Создай простое веб-приложение «Тестовый проект 2». Нужна современная главная страница, заголовок «Тестовый проект 2», краткое описание и красивая кнопка «Начать». Создай все необходимые файлы проекта в GitHub. После разработки обязательно протестируй проект. Если тест обнаружит ошибку — исправь её и повтори тест. Заверши только после VERDICT: PASS.

plan.summary: Create a simple modern web application "Тестовый проект 2" with a homepage containing a title, description, and a styled "Начать" button, host the code in a new GitHub repository, test the UI, fix any issues, and finalize after a PASS verdict.

agents.name: Alex
agents.instructions: Design the project structure, UI mockup, and choose tech stack (HTML5, CSS3, optional lightweight JS). Define repository layout and testing approach.

agents.name: Sam
agents.instructions: Create the GitHub repository, implement index.html, style.css, script.js according to the design, write README, and push all files.

agents.name: Taylor
agents.instructions: Clone the repository, run automated UI tests (e.g., Cypress) to verify the title, description, and button are present and functional.

agents.name: Jordan
agents.instructions: Analyze test failures, modify code to fix UI or functionality issues, and ensure tests pass.

agents.name: Morgan
agents.instructions: Perform final code review for quality, accessibility, security, and confirm that all tests pass before marking the project complete.

steps: Architect designs UI mockup and defines repo structure
Frontend developer creates GitHub repo "test-project-2" and adds project files (index.html, style.css, script.js, README.md)
Frontend developer pushes initial commit to GitHub
Tester clones repo and runs automated UI tests
If tests fail, debugger fixes code and pushes updates
Tester re-runs tests; repeat debug step until all tests pass
Reviewer conducts final code review and confirms PASS verdict
Document final status with VERDICT: PASS
risks: Accidental exposure of GitHub credentials or tokens
Repository may be public unintentionally, leaking code
Automated tests may be flaky across browsers
Design may not meet accessibility standards

plan.summary: Plan to verify state persistence across sessions.

agents.name: StatePersistArchitect
agents.instructions: Design a simple test that writes a known value to persistent storage (e.g., a file) and later reads it back to confirm the value is unchanged.

agents.name: StatePersistDeveloper
agents.instructions: Implement a small script (Python) that writes a predefined string to a temporary file and then reads it back, outputting the result.

agents.name: StatePersistTester
agents.instructions: Execute the script, capture its output, and compare the read value with the original. Report success or mismatch.

agents.name: StatePersistDebugger
agents.instructions: If the tester reports a mismatch or error, investigate the script, fix file handling or path issues, and ensure the script runs in the sandboxed environment.

agents.name: StatePersistReviewer
agents.instructions: Review the final test results and the script code to confirm that state persistence works as intended and that no security concerns exist.

steps: Developer writes Python script using safe temporary directory.
Tester runs script, logs output, compares values.
If failure, Debugger fixes script and retests.
Reviewer validates successful persistence and signs off.
plan.risks: Minimal: script writes to temporary file; ensure sandboxed file system to avoid data leakage. Potential risk of leftover files if cleanup fails.
